incident_title_en: Manipulated audio makes Burkina Faso president appear to condemn US World Cup screening
english_curator_summary: A video reused 2023 footage of Burkina Faso president Ibrahim Traore and replaced the original audio with a fabricated speech criticising US security screening during the 2026 World Cup. AFP Factuel traced the underlying footage and reported that the audio was very probably altered using AI. AAIO preserves that probabilistic attribution rather than describing the tool or creator as established.
system_type: Synthetic audio / likely AI voice manipulation
source_title_original: Attention, ces critiques du président burkinabé sur les contrôles américains au Mondial 2026 ne sont pas authentiques
translation_method: Machine-assisted curator translation and English synthesis from the French source
translation_uncertainty_note: The factual finding is clear; uncertainty remains in the source's own AI attribution ('très probablement' / 'sans doute par IA'), which the English summary retains as 'very probably'.

incident_title_en: AI-generated image falsely depicts Elon Musk visiting Chefchaouen
english_curator_summary: An image shared in Moroccan social-media contexts claimed to show Elon Musk in Chefchaouen. Arabic-language fact-checker Misbar traced the image to the Blue Vibes Art account, which describes its work as AI-generated digital art inspired by Chefchaouen's blue aesthetic, and concluded that the image did not document a real visit. The record concerns deceptive recirculation of an AI-generated artwork, not misconduct by the original artist.

incident_title_en: AI-generated or manipulated images falsely identify suspects in Luanda bank robbery
english_curator_summary: After a robbery at a Banco BAI branch in Luanda's Cidadela area, images circulated on social media and WhatsApp claiming to show the perpetrators. Angolan fact-checker Verifica.ao reported that the circulating images were not authentic photographs of the suspects and had been generated or manipulated using AI. AAIO does not infer the identity of the image creators or claim that the depicted people committed any crime.
harm_types: False identification|Reputational harm risk|Public safety misinformation
